name: Dropdowns, checkboxes, vector rows and colour swatches
body:
# Inspector controls

Choice fields become `<select>`, booleans `<checkbox>`, position/rotation/scale show as one row of three fields with
X/Y/Z colour tags, and the tint field shows a colour swatch beside its hex text. Fields that fail to parse show a red
border and the message in the status bar. Depends on the chaos and penumbra-ui-backend select/checkbox cards and on
`GAME-F02-T02` (text prop updates after mount) so the one-frame refill workaround can go.

comments.text: Done 2026-10-27. InspectorField.chaos uses <select> for choices, <checkbox> for flags, VectorField.chaos for x/y/z triples (merged from the backend's .x/.y/.z fields) and ColorField.chaos with an rgb(attr(...)) swatch. Penumbra's Dropdown now draws its label (D-040).
